description: Decimal expansion of Sum_{k>=1} (zeta(3) - H(k,3))*(H(k)^2 - H(k,2))/(k+1), where H(k) = A001008(k)/A002805(k) is the k-th harmonic number, H(k,2) = A007406(k)/A007407(k) is the k-th generalized harmonic number of order 2, and H(k,3) = A007408(k)/A007409(k) is the k-th generalized harmonic number of order 3.
